points.note: Brass cylinder gear seen roughly end-on at base, lower-left; its axis points toward camera. Center taken from the visible toothed-rim circle; hub itself occluded by the black pillow-block bracket, so the projected rotation-axis point is marked. Closer/more visible of the two.

Second cylinder gear: the helical brass cylinder lying horizontally, meshing with gear 1 and receding back-right into shadow behind the green cone-post casting. Point is the midpoint of the visible cylinder silhouette along its axis; far end occluded so this is approximate.

Topmost/front-most arm of the fan (clearest single arm). In this back-right view the arm is steeply foreshortened: its tip points up-left nearly along the view direction, so the two tip corners collapse close together. tip_left = upper corner of the tip end-face.
Lower corner of the same arm's tip end-face (~15px from tip_left due to foreshortening).
Nearest base corner, where the back face meets the right side face at the bottom (rounded corner).
Far-left end of the base back face (bottom); left/front faces turn away into shadow beyond it.
Far end of the base right-side face (bottom), receding toward the front; in shadow.
Outer top-left corner of the green top-frame casting (left corner post/boss).
Top-frame corner where the back beam meets the right side beam (near-right corner post); partly obscured by the silver rack/lever above.
Outer top-front-right corner of the green top-frame casting (far-right rounded corner).

occluded.reason: Chain sprocket sits beside the crank drive gear on the FRONT/platen side of the machine; not visible from the back-right.
Lower crank-axle sprocket is on the front/occluded side (only a hanging chain segment is glimpsed near the fan pivot).
Cone gear stack is hidden behind the green triangular cone-post casting and in deep shadow at the base.
Butt/pivot end of every fan arm converges at the central column and is occluded by the amplitude-rod bundle and the guide post.
Same as butt_left: pivot end occluded at the central column.
Front-left base corner is on the far side of the machine, occluded.
Front-left top-frame corner is on the far side, occluded behind the casting.

orientation_note: Camera is off the machine's back-right corner: the long green face receding to image-left is the BACK face, the short face receding to image-right is the RIGHT side, and the nearest (lowest) corner where they meet is the back-right corner. Left/front sides face away and are occluded.
